<!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="es">
<head>
<meta charset="UTF-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0">
<title>ZONA PERFUMERIA — Catálogo</title>
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Cormorant+Garamond:ital,wght@0,400;0,500;0,600;1,400&family=Jost:wght@300;400;500;600&display=swap" rel="stylesheet">
<style>
:root{
  --crema:#FFFBF8;
  --negro:#000000;
  --dorado:#685736;
  --dorado-claro:#9c8256;
  --rosado:#FAF3F0;
  --blanco:#FFFFFF;
  --linea:#e7ddd2;
  --texto:#241f19;
  --texto-suave:#6b6156;
}
*{box-sizing:border-box;margin:0;padding:0;}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth;}
body{
  background:var(--crema);
  color:var(--texto);
  font-family:'Jost',sans-serif;
  font-weight:400;
  -webkit-font-smoothing:antialiased;
}
h1,h2,h3,.serif{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;}
img{max-width:100%;display:block;}
a{color:inherit;text-decoration:none;}
button{font-family:inherit;cursor:pointer;border:none;background:none;}
input,select{font-family:inherit;}

/* ---------- Franja superior ---------- */
.top-strip{
  background:var(--negro);
  color:var(--crema);
  font-size:11.5px;
  letter-spacing:.05em;
  text-align:center;
  padding:8px 16px;
}

/* ---------- Hero con logo destacado ---------- */
.brand-hero{
  background:var(--negro);
  padding:46px 24px 40px;
  text-align:center;
  position:relative;
  overflow:hidden;
}
.brand-hero::before,.brand-hero::after{
  content:'';position:absolute;top:0;bottom:0;width:1px;
  background:linear-gradient(var(--negro),rgba(154,130,86,.4),var(--negro));
}
.brand-hero img{
  max-height:190px;width:auto;margin:0 auto;
}
.brand-hero p{
  color:#cdbfa2;font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:16px;
  letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-top:6px;
}

/* ---------- Header sticky ---------- */
header.main{
  background:var(--blanco);
  border-bottom:1px solid var(--linea);
  position:sticky;
  top:0;
  z-index:40;
}
.header-inner{
  max-width:1240px;
  margin:0 auto;
  padding:16px 24px;
  display:flex;
  align-items:center;
  gap:24px;
}
.wordmark{
  font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:23px;font-weight:600;
  letter-spacing:.03em;white-space:nowrap;flex-shrink:0;color:var(--negro);
}
.wordmark span{color:var(--dorado);}
.search-wrap{
  flex:1;
  position:relative;
  max-width:480px;
}
.search-wrap input{
  width:100%;
  padding:11px 16px 11px 40px;
  border:1px solid var(--linea);
  border-radius:2px;
  background:var(--rosado);
  font-size:14px;
  color:var(--texto);
}
.search-wrap input:focus{outline:1px solid var(--dorado);}
.search-icon{
  position:absolute;left:14px;top:50%;transform:translateY(-50%);
  width:15px;height:15px;color:var(--texto-suave);
}
.header-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:20px;margin-left:auto;flex-shrink:0;}
.icon-btn{
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:3px;
  font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--texto);position:relative;
}
.icon-btn svg{width:21px;height:21px;stroke:var(--negro);}
.cart-count{
  position:absolute;top:-6px;right:-10px;
  background:var(--dorado);color:var(--blanco);
  font-size:10px;width:17px;height:17px;border-radius:50%;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-family:'Jost';
}
.whatsapp-btn{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;
  background:var(--dorado);color:var(--blanco);
  padding:9px 16px;border-radius:2px;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.03em;
  white-space:nowrap;
}
.whatsapp-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px;fill:var(--blanco);}

nav.cats{
  border-top:1px solid var(--linea);
  background:var(--blanco);
}
.cats-inner{
  max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:0 24px;
  display:flex;gap:28px;overflow-x:auto;
}
.cats-inner button{
  padding:12px 0;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.03em;color:var(--texto-suave);
  border-bottom:2px solid transparent;white-space:nowrap;
}
.cats-inner button.active,.cats-inner button:hover{color:var(--negro);border-bottom-color:var(--dorado);}

/* ---------- Catalog title ---------- */
.catalog-hero{
  max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:40px 24px 0;
}
.catalog-hero h1{
  font-size:34px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:.02em;color:var(--negro);
}
.catalog-hero p{
  margin-top:6px;color:var(--texto-suave);font-size:14px;max-width:520px;
}

/* ---------- Layout: sidebar + grid ---------- */
.shop-layout{
  max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;padding:28px 24px 90px;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:250px 1fr;gap:40px;
  align-items:start;
}
.filters-sidebar{
  border-right:1px solid var(--linea);padding-right:28px;
  position:sticky;top:100px;
}
.filter-group{padding:20px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--linea);}
.filter-group:first-child{padding-top:0;}
.filter-group h4{
  font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--negro);
  margin-bottom:12px;font-family:'Jost';font-weight:500;
}
.filter-check{
  display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;font-size:13.5px;color:var(--texto);
  padding:5px 0;cursor:pointer;
}
.filter-check input{
  width:15px;height:15px;accent-color:var(--dorado);cursor:pointer;
}
.filter-check .count{color:var(--texto-suave);font-size:11.5px;margin-left:auto;}
.clear-filters{
  font-size:12px;color:var(--dorado);border-bottom:1px solid var(--dorado);
  margin-top:6px;display:inline-block;
}

.grid-col{min-width:0;}
.grid-toolbar{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
  padding-bottom:18px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--linea);margin-bottom:22px;
  gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;
}
.results-count{font-size:13px;color:var(--texto-suave);}
.sort-wrap{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:9px;}
.sort-wrap label{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--texto-suave);text-transform:uppercase;}
.sort-wrap select{
  border:1px solid var(--linea);background:var(--blanco);
  padding:8px 10px;font-size:13px;border-radius:2px;color:var(--texto);
}
.sort-wrap select:focus{outline:1px solid var(--dorado);}

.grid{
  display:grid;
  grid-template-columns:repeat(auto-fill,minmax(215px,1fr));
  gap:26px 20px;
}
.card{
  background:var(--blanco);
  border:1px solid var(--linea);
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
  transition:box-shadow .2s ease, transform .2s ease;
  position:relative;
}
.card:hover{box-shadow:0 10px 26px rgba(36,31,25,.09);transform:translateY(-2px);}
.card-img{
  aspect-ratio:1/1;background:var(--rosado);position:relative;overflow:hidden;cursor:pointer;
}
.card-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;}
.card-img .hover-cta{
  position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0 0;
  background:rgba(0,0,0,.78);color:var(--crema);
  text-align:center;padding:10px;font-size:11.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;
  transform:translateY(100%);transition:transform .2s ease;
}
.card-img:hover .hover-cta{transform:translateY(0);}
.card-icons{
  position:absolute;top:9px;right:9px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px;z-index:3;
}
.card-icon-btn{
  width:30px;height:30px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(255,255,255,.92);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;
  box-shadow:0 2px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.15);
}
.card-icon-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px;}
.fav-btn svg{stroke:var(--negro);fill:none;stroke-width:1.6;transition:fill .15s,stroke .15s;}
.fav-btn.active svg{fill:#c0392b;stroke:#c0392b;}
.whatsapp-mini svg{fill:var(--dorado);}
.card-body{padding:14px 15px 16px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:5px;flex:1;}
.card-brand{font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--dorado);text-transform:uppercase;}
.card-name{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:18px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;line-height:1.15;}
.card-meta{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--texto-suave);}
.card-notes{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--texto-suave);}
.card-bottom{margin-top:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;padding-top:9px;}
.card-price{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:19px;color:var(--negro);}
.add-btn{
  background:var(--negro);color:var(--crema);
  font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.06em;padding:9px 12px;
}
.add-btn:hover{background:var(--dorado);}
.no-results{padding:70px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--texto-suave);grid-column:1/-1;}

@media(max-width:860px){
  .shop-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr;}
  .filters-sidebar{
    position:static;border-right:none;padding-right:0;
    border-bottom:1px solid var(--linea);padding-bottom:10px;margin-bottom:10px;
  }
}

/* ---------- Modal producto ---------- */
.overlay{
  position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(20,16,12,.55);
  display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:100;padding:20px;
}
.overlay.open{display:flex;}
.modal{
  background:var(--blanco);max-width:880px;width:100%;max-height:88vh;overflow:auto;
  display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;position:relative;
}
@media(max-width:680px){.modal{grid-template-columns:1fr;}}
.modal-close{
  position:absolute;top:14px;right:14px;width:30px;height:30px;
  background:var(--blanco);border:1px solid var(--linea);border-radius:50%;
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;z-index:5;
}
.modal-img{background:var(--rosado);}
.modal-img img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;min-height:280px;}
.modal-info{padding:34px 32px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;}
.modal-brand{font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--dorado);text-transform:uppercase;}
.modal-info h2{font-size:29px;font-weight:500;}
.modal-price{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:25px;}
.modal-meta{font-size:13px;color:var(--texto-suave);}
.modal-tags{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;}
.tag{
  border:1px solid var(--dorado-claro);color:var(--dorado);
  font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.05em;padding:4px 10px;border-radius:20px;text-transform:uppercase;
}
.modal-desc{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.65;color:var(--texto);margin-top:4px;}
.qty-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;margin-top:6px;}
.qty-box{
  display:flex;align-items:center;border:1px solid var(--linea);
}
.qty-box button{width:34px;height:34px;font-size:16px;}
.qty-box span{width:36px;text-align:center;font-size:14px;}
.modal-actions{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;margin-top:10px;}
.btn-primary{
  background:var(--negro);color:var(--crema);padding:13px;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.07em;text-align:center;
}
.btn-primary:hover{background:var(--dorado);}
.btn-whatsapp{
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;
  background:#fff;border:1px solid var(--dorado);color:var(--dorado);
  padding:13px;font-size:12.5px;letter-spacing:.05em;
}
.btn-whatsapp svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:var(--dorado);}
.btn-whatsapp:hover{background:var(--rosado);}

/* ---------- Carrito lateral ---------- */
.cart-overlay{
  position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(20,16,12,.5);z-index:110;
  display:none;
}
.cart-overlay.open{display:block;}
.cart-panel{
  position:fixed;top:0;right:0;height:100%;width:400px;max-width:92vw;
  background:var(--blanco);z-index:120;
  transform:translateX(100%);transition:transform .28s ease;
  display:flex;flex-direction:column;
}
.cart-panel.open{transform:translateX(0);}
.cart-head{
  padding:22px 22px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--linea);
  display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;
}
.cart-head h3{font-size:22px;font-weight:500;}
.cart-head button{font-size:22px;line-height:1;}
.cart-items{flex:1;overflow:auto;padding:14px 22px;}
.cart-item{display:flex;gap:12px;padding:14px 0;border-bottom:1px solid var(--linea);}
.cart-item img{width:64px;height:64px;object-fit:cover;background:var(--rosado);flex-shrink:0;}
.cart-item-info{flex:1;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:4px;}
.cart-item-info .name{font-size:14px;font-weight:500;}
.cart-item-info .meta{font-size:11.5px;color:var(--texto-suave);}
.cart-item-row{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;margin-top:4px;}
.cart-item-row .qty-box button{width:26px;height:26px;font-size:13px;}
.cart-item-row .qty-box span{width:26px;font-size:13px;}
.cart-item-row .price{font-size:13.5px;}
.remove-btn{font-size:11px;color:var(--texto-suave);text-decoration:underline;}
.cart-empty{padding:60px 0;text-align:center;color:var(--texto-suave);font-size:14px;}
.cart-foot{border-top:1px solid var(--linea);padding:18px 22px 24px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px;}
.subtotal-row{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;font-size:15px;}
.subtotal-row .amt{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:22px;}

/* ---------- Footer ---------- */
footer{
  background:var(--negro);color:var(--crema);margin-top:0;
  padding:40px 24px 26px;
}
.footer-inner{max-width:1240px;margin:0 auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:space-between;gap:24px;}
.footer-inner .brand{font-family:'Cormorant Garamond',serif;font-size:24px;color:var(--dorado-claro);}
.footer-inner p{font-size:12px;color:#c9c1b4;margin-top:8px;max-width:320px;line-height:1.6;}
.footer-note{max-width:1240px;margin:24px auto 0;padding-top:18px;border-top:1px solid #2a2a2a;font-size:11px;color:#9a9284;text-align:center;}

@media(max-width:720px){
  .header-inner{flex-wrap:wrap;}
  .search-wrap{order:3;max-width:none;width:100%;}
  .catalog-hero h1{font-size:27px;}
  .brand-hero img{max-height:120px;}
}
</style>
</head>
<body>

<div class="top-strip">Envíos a todo el Perú · Escríbenos por WhatsApp para asesoría personalizada</div>

<div class="brand-hero">
  <a href="#" onclick="window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});return false;">
    <img id="logo-hero" src="" alt="ZONA PERFUMERIA">
  </a>
  <p>Perfumería fina</p>
</div>

<header class="main">
  <div class="header-inner">
    <a href="#" class="wordmark" onclick="window.scrollTo({top:0,behavior:'smooth'});return false;">ZONA<span> PERFUMERIA</span></a>
    <div class="search-wrap">
      <svg class="search-icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2"><circle cx="11" cy="11" r="7"/><line x1="21" y1="21" x2="16.65" y2="16.65"/></svg>
      <input id="search-input" type="text" placeholder="Buscar perfume, marca o nota...">
    </div>
    <div class="header-actions">
      <a class="icon-btn" href="#">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M20 21v-2a4 4 0 0 0-4-4H8a4 4 0 0 0-4 4v2"/><circle cx="12" cy="7" r="4"/></svg>
        Mi cuenta
      </a>
      <button class="icon-btn" onclick="toggleFavView()" id="fav-header-btn">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><path d="M20.8 4.6a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-7.8 0L12 5.6l-1-1a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-7.8 7.8l1 1L12 21l7.8-7.8 1-1a5.5 5.5 0 0 0 0-7.6z"/></svg>
        Favoritos
        <span class="cart-count" id="fav-count" style="display:none;">0</span>
      </button>
      <button class="icon-btn" onclick="openCart()">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.6"><circle cx="9" cy="21" r="1"/><circle cx="20" cy="21" r="1"/><path d="M1 1h4l2.68 13.39a2 2 0 0 0 2 1.61h9.72a2 2 0 0 0 2-1.61L23 6H6"/></svg>
        Carrito
        <span class="cart-count" id="cart-count" style="display:none;">0</span>
      </button>
      <a class="whatsapp-btn" id="header-whatsapp" href="#" target="_blank">
        <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12.04 2C6.58 2 2.13 6.45 2.13 11.91c0 1.75.46 3.45 1.32 4.95L2.05 22l5.25-1.38a9.9 9.9 0 0 0 4.74 1.21h.01c5.46 0 9.91-4.45 9.91-9.91 0-2.65-1.03-5.14-2.9-7.01A9.82 9.82 0 0 0 12.04 2zm5.8 14.14c-.24.68-1.4 1.32-1.93 1.4-.49.08-1.11.11-1.79-.11-.41-.13-.94-.31-1.62-.6-2.85-1.23-4.71-4.1-4.85-4.29-.14-.19-1.16-1.55-1.16-2.96 0-1.41.74-2.1 1-2.39.26-.29.57-.36.76-.36.19 0 .38 0 .55.01.18.01.41-.07.64.49.24.58.81 2 .88 2.15.07.15.12.32.02.51-.09.19-.14.31-.28.48-.14.17-.29.37-.42.5-.14.14-.29.29-.12.57.16.28.72 1.19 1.55 1.92 1.06.95 1.96 1.24 2.24 1.38.28.14.44.12.6-.07.16-.19.68-.79.87-1.07.18-.28.37-.23.62-.14.26.09 1.63.77 1.91.91.28.14.47.21.54.33.07.12.07.68-.17 1.36z"/></svg>
        WhatsApp
      </a>
    </div>
  </div>
  <nav class="cats">
    <div class="cats-inner" id="cats-inner"></div>
  </nav>
</header>

<section class="catalog-hero">
  <h1 class="serif">Todos los perfumes</h1>
  <p>Fragancias inspiradas en las mejores casas de perfumería del mundo — 100&nbsp;referencias seleccionadas, en soles, con despacho a todo el Perú.</p>
</section>

<div class="shop-layout">
  <aside class="filters-sidebar">
    <div class="filter-group">
      <h4>Género</h4>
      <div id="f-gender"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="filter-group">
      <h4>Marca</h4>
      <div id="f-brand"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="filter-group">
      <h4>Familia olfativa</h4>
      <div id="f-familia"></div>
    </div>
    <div class="filter-group">
      <h4>Precio</h4>
      <div id="f-price"></div>
    </div>
    <button class="clear-filters" onclick="clearFilters()">Limpiar filtros</button>
  </aside>

  <div class="grid-col">
    <div id="fav-banner" style="display:none;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;background:var(--rosado);border:1px solid var(--linea);padding:12px 16px;margin-bottom:18px;font-size:13px;">
      <span>Mostrando tu lista de <strong>favoritos</strong></span>
      <button style="color:var(--dorado);text-decoration:underline;font-size:12px;" onclick="toggleFavView()">Ver todo el catálogo</button>
    </div>
    <div class="grid-toolbar">
      <div class="results-count" id="results-count"></div>
      <div class="sort-wrap">
        <label>Ordenar por</label>
        <select id="f-sort">
          <option value="destacados">Destacados</option>
          <option value="recientes">Más recientes</option>
          <option value="vendidos">Más vendidos</option>
          <option value="precio-asc">Precio: menor a mayor</option>
          <option value="precio-desc">Precio: mayor a menor</option>
          <option value="nombre-asc">Nombre A–Z</option>
        </select>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="grid" id="product-grid"></div>
  </div>
</div>

<footer>
  <div class="footer-inner">
    <div>
      <div class="brand serif">ZONA PERFUMERIA</div>
      <p>Perfumes inspirados de alta calidad, seleccionados para durar. Atención personalizada por WhatsApp.</p>
    </div>
    <div>
      <p style="font-size:12px;">Escríbenos: <span id="footer-phone">+51 900 000 000</span></p>
      <p style="font-size:12px;">Pagos, envíos y cambios coordinados por WhatsApp.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="footer-note">© ZONA PERFUMERIA — Catálogo de demostración</div>
</footer>

<!-- Modal producto -->
<div class="overlay" id="product-overlay" onclick="if(event.target===this)closeModal()">
  <div class="modal">
    <button class="modal-close" onclick="closeModal()">✕</button>
    <div class="modal-img"><img id="modal-img" src="" alt=""></div>
    <div class="modal-info">
      <div class="modal-brand" id="modal-brand"></div>
      <h2 class="serif" id="modal-name"></h2>
      <div class="modal-price serif" id="modal-price"></div>
      <div class="modal-meta" id="modal-meta"></div>
      <div class="modal-tags" id="modal-tags"></div>
      <p class="modal-desc" id="modal-desc"></p>
      <div class="qty-row">
        <label style="font-size:12px;color:var(--texto-suave);">Cantidad:</label>
        <div class="qty-box">
          <button onclick="modalQty(-1)">−</button>

const LOGO_B64 = "data:image/jpeg;base64,";
document.getElementById('logo-hero').src = LOGO_B64;

// ---------- Estado ----------
let cart = JSON.parse(sessionStorage.getItem('zp_cart') || '[]');
let currentModalId = null;
let modalQtyVal = 1;
let activeCat = 'todos';
let searchTerm = '';
let selectedGenders = [];
let selectedFamilias = [];
let selectedBrands = [];
let selectedPrice = '';

function saveCart(){ sessionStorage.setItem('zp_cart', JSON.stringify(cart)); }
function money(n){ return 'S/ ' + n.toFixed(2); }
function uniqueSorted(arr){ return [...new Set(arr)].sort((a,b)=>a.localeCompare(b,'es')); }

const PRICE_RANGES = [
  {key:'0-120', label:'Hasta S/120'},
  {key:'121-150', label:'S/121 – S/150'},
  {key:'151-180', label:'S/151 – S/180'},
  {key:'181-220', label:'S/181 – S/220'},
  {key:'221-99999', label:'Más de S/220'},
];

// ---------- Construir filtros dinámicos ----------
function buildFilterOptions(){
  const genders = uniqueSorted(PRODUCTS.map(p=>p.gender));
  const familias = uniqueSorted(PRODUCTS.flatMap(p=>p.familias));
  const brands = uniqueSorted(PRODUCTS.map(p=>p.brand));

  const gWrap = document.getElementById('f-gender');
  genders.forEach(g=>{
    const count = PRODUCTS.filter(p=>p.gender===g).length;
    const lbl = document.createElement('label'); lbl.className='filter-check';
    lbl.innerHTML = `<input type="checkbox" value="${g}"> ${g} <span class="count">${count}</span>`;
    lbl.querySelector('input').addEventListener('change', e=>{
      toggleInArray(selectedGenders, g, e.target.checked); render();
    });
    gWrap.appendChild(lbl);
  });

  const bWrap = document.getElementById('f-brand');
  brands.forEach(b=>{
    const count = PRODUCTS.filter(p=>p.brand===b).length;
    const lbl = document.createElement('label'); lbl.className='filter-check';
    lbl.innerHTML = `<input type="checkbox" value="${b}"> ${b} <span class="count">${count}</span>`;
    lbl.querySelector('input').addEventListener('change', e=>{
      toggleInArray(selectedBrands, b, e.target.checked); render();
    });
    bWrap.appendChild(lbl);
  });

  const fWrap = document.getElementById('f-familia');
  familias.forEach(f=>{
    const count = PRODUCTS.filter(p=>p.familias.includes(f)).length;
    const lbl = document.createElement('label'); lbl.className='filter-check';
    lbl.innerHTML = `<input type="checkbox" value="${f}"> ${f} <span class="count">${count}</span>`;
    lbl.querySelector('input').addEventListener('change', e=>{
      toggleInArray(selectedFamilias, f, e.target.checked); render();
    });
    fWrap.appendChild(lbl);
  });

  const pWrap = document.getElementById('f-price');
  PRICE_RANGES.forEach(r=>{
    const [min,max] = r.key.split('-').map(Number);
    const count = PRODUCTS.filter(p=>p.price>=min && p.price<=max).length;
    const lbl = document.createElement('label'); lbl.className='filter-check';
    lbl.innerHTML = `<input type="radio" name="price" value="${r.key}"> ${r.label} <span class="count">${count}</span>`;
    lbl.querySelector('input').addEventListener('change', e=>{
      selectedPrice = e.target.checked ? r.key : '';
      render();
    });
    pWrap.appendChild(lbl);
  });

  const catsWrap = document.getElementById('cats-inner');
  const cats = [{k:'todos',label:'Todos los perfumes'}, ...genders.map(g=>({k:g,label:g}))];
  cats.forEach(c=>{
    const btn = document.createElement('button');
    btn.textContent = c.label;
    btn.dataset.cat = c.k;
    if(c.k==='todos') btn.classList.add('active');
    btn.onclick = ()=>{ activeCat=c.k; document.querySelectorAll('.cats-inner button').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('active')); btn.classList.add('active'); render(); };
    catsWrap.appendChild(btn);
  });
}

function toggleInArray(arr, val, checked){
  const i = arr.indexOf(val);
  if(checked && i===-1) arr.push(val);
  if(!checked && i>-1) arr.splice(i,1);
}

// ---------- Filtrado / orden ----------
function getFiltered(){
  const sort = document.getElementById('f-sort').value;

  let list = PRODUCTS.filter(p=>{
    if(activeCat!=='todos' && p.gender!==activeCat) return false;
    if(selectedGenders.length && !selectedGenders.includes(p.gender)) return false;
    if(selectedFamilias.length && !selectedFamilias.some(f=>p.familias.includes(f))) return false;
    if(selectedBrands.length && !selectedBrands.includes(p.brand)) return false;
    if(selectedPrice){
      const [min,max] = selectedPrice.split('-').map(Number);
      if(p.price<min || p.price>max) return false;
    }
    if(searchTerm){
      const hay = (p.name+' '+p.brand+' '+p.desc+' '+p.familias.join(' ')).toLowerCase();
      if(!hay.includes(searchTerm.toLowerCase())) return false;
    }
    return true;
  });

  if(sort==='precio-asc') list.sort((a,b)=>a.price-b.price);
  else if(sort==='precio-desc') list.sort((a,b)=>b.price-a.price);
  else if(sort==='nombre-asc') list.sort((a,b)=>a.name.localeCompare(b.name,'es'));
  else if(sort==='recientes') list.sort((a,b)=>b.id-a.id);
  else if(sort==='vendidos') list.sort((a,b)=>a.id-b.id);
  // 'destacados' mantiene el orden original del catálogo

  return list;
}

function clearFilters(){
  selectedGenders = []; selectedFamilias = []; selectedBrands = []; selectedPrice='';
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-check input[type=checkbox]').forEach(i=>i.checked=false);
  document.querySelectorAll('.filter-check input[type=radio]').forEach(i=>i.checked=false);
  document.getElementById('f-sort').value='destacados';
  document.getElementById('search-input').value='';
  searchTerm='';
  activeCat='todos';
  document.querySelectorAll('.cats-inner button').forEach(b=>b.classList.toggle('active', b.dataset.cat==='todos'));
  render();
}

// ---------- Render grid ----------
function render(){
  const grid = document.getElementById('product-grid');
  let list = getFiltered();
  if(favView) list = list.filter(p=>favorites.includes(p.id));
  document.getElementById('fav-banner').style.display = favView ? 'flex' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('results-count').textContent = list.length + (list.length===1 ? ' perfume' : ' perfumes');
  grid.innerHTML = '';
  if(list.length===0){
    grid.innerHTML = favView
      ? '<div class="no-results">Aún no guardaste perfumes en favoritos. Toca el corazón ♡ en cualquier perfume para guardarlo aquí.</div>'
      : '<div class="no-results">No encontramos perfumes con esos filtros. Prueba ajustando la búsqueda.</div>';
    return;
  }
  list.forEach(p=>{
    const card = document.createElement('div');
    card.className='card';
    const isFav = favorites.includes(p.id);
    card.innerHTML = `
      <div class="card-img" onclick="openModal(${p.id})">
        <img src="${p.img}" alt="${p.name}" loading="lazy" onerror="this.src='https://via.placeholder.com/400x400/FAF3F0/685736?text=ZONA+PERFUMERIA'">
        <div class="card-icons">
          <button class="card-icon-btn fav-btn${isFav?' active':''}" onclick="event.stopPropagation();toggleFav(${p.id})" title="Agregar a favoritos">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M20.8 4.6a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-7.8 0L12 5.6l-1-1a5.5 5.5 0 0 0-7.8 7.8l1 1L12 21l7.8-7.8 1-1a5.5 5.5 0 0 0 0-7.6z"/></svg>
          </button>
          <button class="card-icon-btn whatsapp-mini" onclick="event.stopPropagation();consultarWhatsapp(${p.id})" title="Consultar por WhatsApp">
            <svg viewBox="0 0 24 24"><path d="M12.04 2C6.58 2 2.13 6.45 2.13 11.91c0 1.75.46 3.45 1.32 4.95L2.05 22l5.25-1.38a9.9 9.9 0 0 0 4.74 1.21h.01c5.46 0 9.91-4.45 9.91-9.91 0-2.65-1.03-5.14-2.9-7.01A9.82 9.82 0 0 0 12.04 2zm5.8 14.14c-.24.68-1.4 1.32-1.93 1.4-.49.08-1.11.11-1.79-.11-.41-.13-.94-.31-1.62-.6-2.85-1.23-4.71-4.1-4.85-4.29-.14-.19-1.16-1.55-1.16-2.96 0-1.41.74-2.1 1-2.39.26-.29.57-.36.76-.36.19 0 .38 0 .55.01.18.01.41-.07.64.49.24.58.81 2 .88 2.15.07.15.12.32.02.51-.09.19-.14.31-.28.48-.14.17-.29.37-.42.5-.14.14-.29.29-.12.57.16.28.72 1.19 1.55 1.92 1.06.95 1.96 1.24 2.24 1.38.28.14.44.12.6-.07.16-.19.68-.79.87-1.07.18-.28.37-.23.62-.14.26.09 1.63.77 1.91.91.28.14.47.21.54.33.07.12.07.68-.17 1.36z"/></svg>
          </button>
        </div>
        <div class="hover-cta">VER PERFUME</div>
      </div>
      <div class="card-body">
        <div class="card-brand">${p.brand}</div>
        <div class="card-name serif" onclick="openModal(${p.id})">${p.name}</div>
        <div class="card-meta">${p.size} · ${p.type||'Perfume'}</div>
        <div class="card-notes">${p.familias.join(' · ')}</div>
        <div class="card-bottom">
          <div class="card-price serif">${money(p.price)}</div>
          <button class="add-btn" onclick="quickAdd(${p.id})">AGREGAR</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
    grid.appendChild(card);
  });
}

// ---------- Favoritos ----------
let favorites = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('zp_favorites') || '[]');
let favView = false;
function saveFavorites(){ localStorage.setItem('zp_favorites', JSON.stringify(favorites)); }
function toggleFav(id){
  const i = favorites.indexOf(id);
  if(i>-1) favorites.splice(i,1); else favorites.push(id);
  saveFavorites();
  updateFavCount();
  render();
}
function updateFavCount(){
  const el = document.getElementById('fav-count');
  if(favorites.length>0){ el.style.display='flex'; el.textContent=favorites.length; } else { el.style.display='none'; }
  document.getElementById('fav-header-btn').style.color = favView ? 'var(--dorado)' : 'var(--texto)';
}
function toggleFavView(){
  favView = !favView;
  window.scrollTo({top:document.querySelector('.shop-layout').offsetTop-90, behavior:'smooth'});
  updateFavCount();
  render();
}
function consultarWhatsapp(id){
  const p = PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===id);
  const msg = `Hola, quiero consultar disponibilidad de ${p.name} ${p.size}. ¿Lo tienen en stock?`;
  window.open(`https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`, '_blank');
}

// ---------- Modal producto ----------
function openModal(id){
  const p = PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===id);
  currentModalId = id;
  modalQtyVal = 1;
  document.getElementById('modal-qty').textContent = 1;
  document.getElementById('modal-img').src = p.img;
  document.getElementById('modal-img').onerror = function(){ this.src='https://via.placeholder.com/600x600/FAF3F0/685736?text=ZONA+PERFUMERIA'; };
  document.getElementById('modal-brand').textContent = p.brand;
  document.getElementById('modal-name').textContent = p.name;
  document.getElementById('modal-price').textContent = money(p.price);
  document.getElementById('modal-meta').textContent = `${p.size} · ${p.type||'Perfume'} · ${p.gender}`;
  document.getElementById('modal-tags').innerHTML = p.familias.map(f=>`<span class="tag">${f}</span>`).join('');
  document.getElementById('modal-desc').textContent = p.desc;
  updateModalFavLabel();
  document.getElementById('product-overlay').classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
}
function updateModalFavLabel(){
  const isFav = favorites.includes(currentModalId);
  document.getElementById('modal-fav-label').textContent = isFav ? 'GUARDADO EN FAVORITOS' : 'GUARDAR EN FAVORITOS';
  document.getElementById('modal-fav-btn').style.borderColor = isFav ? 'var(--dorado)' : 'var(--linea)';
  document.getElementById('modal-fav-btn').style.color = isFav ? 'var(--dorado)' : 'var(--texto)';
}
function toggleModalFav(){
  toggleFav(currentModalId);
  updateModalFavLabel();
}
function closeModal(){
  document.getElementById('product-overlay').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='';
}
function modalQty(delta){
  modalQtyVal = Math.max(1, modalQtyVal+delta);
  document.getElementById('modal-qty').textContent = modalQtyVal;
}
function addToCartFromModal(){
  addToCart(currentModalId, modalQtyVal);
  closeModal();
  openCart();
}
function buyOneViaWhatsapp(){
  const p = PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===currentModalId);
  const total = p.price*modalQtyVal;
  const msg = `Hola, quiero comprar:\n${p.name} ${p.size} x${modalQtyVal}\nTotal: ${money(total)}`;
  window.open(`https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`, '_blank');
}

// ---------- Carrito ----------
function quickAdd(id){ addToCart(id,1); openCart(); }
function addToCart(id, qty){
  const existing = cart.find(i=>i.id===id);
  if(existing) existing.qty += qty;
  else cart.push({id, qty});
  saveCart();
  updateCartCount();
  renderCart();
}
function updateCartCount(){
  const count = cart.reduce((s,i)=>s+i.qty,0);
  const el = document.getElementById('cart-count');
  if(count>0){ el.style.display='flex'; el.textContent=count; } else { el.style.display='none'; }
}
function changeQty(id, delta){
  const item = cart.find(i=>i.id===id);
  if(!item) return;
  item.qty += delta;
  if(item.qty<=0) cart = cart.filter(i=>i.id!==id);
  saveCart();
  updateCartCount();
  renderCart();
}
function removeFromCart(id){
  cart = cart.filter(i=>i.id!==id);
  saveCart();
  updateCartCount();
  renderCart();
}
function renderCart(){
  const wrap = document.getElementById('cart-items');
  if(cart.length===0){
    wrap.innerHTML = '<div class="cart-empty">Tu carrito está vacío.</div>';
    document.getElementById('cart-subtotal').textContent = money(0);
    return;
  }
  let subtotal = 0;
  wrap.innerHTML = cart.map(item=>{
    const p = PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===item.id);
    const lineTotal = p.price*item.qty;
    subtotal += lineTotal;
    return `
      <div class="cart-item">
        <img src="${p.img}" alt="${p.name}" onerror="this.src='https://via.placeholder.com/100x100/FAF3F0/685736?text=ZP'">
        <div class="cart-item-info">
          <div class="name">${p.name}</div>
          <div class="meta">${p.size} · ${p.type||''}</div>
          <div class="cart-item-row">
            <div class="qty-box">
              <button onclick="changeQty(${p.id},-1)">−</button>
              <span>${item.qty}</span>
              <button onclick="changeQty(${p.id},1)">+</button>
            </div>
            <div class="price serif">${money(lineTotal)}</div>
          </div>
          <button class="remove-btn" onclick="removeFromCart(${p.id})">Quitar</button>
        </div>
      </div>
    `;
  }).join('');
  document.getElementById('cart-subtotal').textContent = money(subtotal);
}
function openCart(){
  renderCart();
  document.getElementById('cart-overlay').classList.add('open');
  document.getElementById('cart-panel').classList.add('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='hidden';
}
function closeCart(){
  document.getElementById('cart-overlay').classList.remove('open');
  document.getElementById('cart-panel').classList.remove('open');
  document.body.style.overflow='';
}
function checkoutWhatsapp(){
  if(cart.length===0) return;
  let lines = ['Hola, quiero comprar:'];
  let total = 0;
  cart.forEach(item=>{
    const p = PRODUCTS.find(x=>x.id===item.id);
    const lineTotal = p.price*item.qty;
    total += lineTotal;
    lines.push(`${p.name} ${p.size} x${item.qty}`);
  });
  lines.push(`Total: ${money(total)}`);
  const msg = lines.join('\n');
  window.open(`https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}?text=${encodeURIComponent(msg)}`, '_blank');
}

// ---------- Buscador ----------
document.getElementById('search-input').addEventListener('input', (e)=>{
  searchTerm = e.target.value;
  render();
});
document.getElementById('f-sort').addEventListener('change', render);

// WhatsApp header link
document.getElementById('header-whatsapp').href = `https://wa.me/${WHATSAPP_NUMBER}`;
document.getElementById('footer-phone').textContent = '+' + WHATSAPP_NUMBER;

// ---------- Init ----------
buildFilterOptions();
updateCartCount();
updateFavCount();
render();
</script>
</body>
</html>
